disposition_reason: Prints per-sample lead, cadmium and chromium for 39 canned cheeses of Iraqi, Iranian and Turkish origin with group means and ranges.

study.design: Market survey of locally produced and imported canned cheeses
study.origin: Produced in Iraq (9), Iran (15) and Turkey (15), as labelled
study.method: HNO3/HClO4 digestion after drying at 70 °C for 24 h; AAS (Shimadzu AA-7000, graphite furnace)
study.qa: Calibration standards only; no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: Basis not stated; samples dried at 70 °C before digestion, so results may be dry weight
Printed ± values labelled S.D. look more like standard errors given the spread of sample values
Means appear to treat ND as zero (e.g. Iraqi Cr mean 0.015 = 0.131/9)
Several Pb values (e.g. 1.39, 1.86, 2.79, 3.25, 4.64, 5.57, 8.36) recur across many samples, suggesting coarse calibration steps
Table 1 lists brand names; findings use retail product codes instead
Different dataset from the same authors' Najaf cadmium paper (muneam2023-najaf-imported-cheese-cadmium: 72 samples, September 2022); not a reprint
